tables.name: session_counter
tables.def:
CREATE TABLE `session_counter` (
  `id` int NOT NULL AUTO_INCREMENT,
  `session_id` varchar(255) COLLATE utf8mb4_general_ci NOT NULL,
  `count` int NOT NULL,
  `created_at` timestamp NOT NULL DEFAULT CURRENT_TIMESTAMP,
  `updated_at` timestamp NOT NULL DEFAULT CURRENT_TIMESTAMP ON UPDATE CURRENT_TIMESTAMP,
  PRIMARY KEY (`id`),
  UNIQUE KEY `session_id` (`session_id`)
) ENGINE=InnoDB AUTO_INCREMENT=[Redacted by tbls] DEFAULT CHARSET=utf8mb4 COLLATE=utf8mb4_general_ci

tables.name: status_history
tables.def:
CREATE TABLE `status_history` (
  `id` int NOT NULL AUTO_INCREMENT,
  `start_date` datetime NOT NULL,
  `end_date` datetime NOT NULL,
  `count` decimal(10,0) NOT NULL,
  `created_at` timestamp NOT NULL DEFAULT CURRENT_TIMESTAMP,
  `updated_at` timestamp NOT NULL DEFAULT CURRENT_TIMESTAMP ON UPDATE CURRENT_TIMESTAMP,
  `status` enum('DIRTY','UNCLEAN','CLEAN','IMMACULATE','SPOTLESS') COLLATE utf8mb4_general_ci NOT NULL,
  PRIMARY KEY (`id`)
) ENGINE=InnoDB AUTO_INCREMENT=[Redacted by tbls] DEFAULT CHARSET=utf8mb4 COLLATE=utf8mb4_general_ci
